# bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/append_ligand

## Summary

This class takes a ligand ITP file and inserts it in a topology.

This module automatizes the process of inserting a ligand ITP file in a GROMACS topology.

Nextflow adapter of the [AppendLigand](https://biobb-gromacs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs_extra.html#gromacs-extra-append-ligand-module) building block of [biobb_gromacs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_gromacs) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_GROMACS_APPEND_LIGAND } from 'bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/append_ligand'

workflow {
    BIOBB_GROMACS_APPEND_LIGAND(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_top_zip_path` | yes | zip | Path the input topology TOP and ITP files zipball |
| `input_itp_path` | yes | itp | Path to the ligand ITP file to be inserted in the topology |
| `input_posres_itp_path` | no | itp | Path to the position restriction ITP file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_top_zip_path` | yes | zip | Path/Name the output topology TOP and ITP files zipball |
| `versions_biobb_gromacs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_gromacs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of AppendLigand properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_top_zip_path: 'zip']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_gromacs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_GROMACS_APPEND_LIGAND' {
        ext.properties = [posres_name: 'POSRES_LIGAND']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `posres_name` | string | "POSRES_LIGAND" | String to be included in the ifdef clause. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
